prompts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one polished landscape 16:9 gameplay screenshot concept for a solo-developed low-poly 3D narrative puzzle game titled "내일의 지도". Actual gameplay view, not poster or advertising, no desktop/device frame. Orthographic three-quarter camera looking at a compact miniature city block on a municipal planning desk. Simple flat shaded modular geometry achievable with Kenney-style building and road assets, matte cream stucco houses, muted terracotta roofs, sage trees, warm window lights, restrained teal shadows. Central 70% of screen is a legible city diorama with about 10 buildings, small hospital, narrow alleys, tiny simple residents and doors; no realistic detailed human faces. Show the core mechanic clearly: one street segment outlined in turquoise and a translucent pale ghost of a building moved one tile aside, opening a route from houses to hospital. An overlooked basement entrance is marked with a small amber caution sign. A subtle paper grid below the city. Afternoon angled light and soft ambient occlusion, intimate slightly unsettling town planning mood. Tasteful sparse Korean UI integrated at screen edges, crisp readable typography: top left "내일의 지도", top right "3일차 · 승인 전". Small lower-left inset blueprint of exactly the same city grid with selected route, labelled "수정 도면". Narrow right panel headed "오늘의 민원" with two concise rows "병원 진입로 연결" and "지하 세입자 출입구"; below it two understated controls "변경 취소" and a teal primary button "도면 승인". Small bottom hint "선을 바꾸면, 내일의 도시가 바뀝니다." Do not overwhelm city with panels. Controlled professional art direction, realistic indie production scope, physical depth but distinctly simplified low-poly geometry. No glossy plastic, no photorealism, no dramatic cinematic letterboxing, no gratuitous fantasy castle, no brand logos, no watermarks. This is a proposed visual mockup, not a claim of existing implemented gameplay.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create one polished landscape 16:9 gameplay screenshot concept for a solo-developed low-poly 3D farm management survival game titled "밭이 줄어드는 세계". Actual playable-looking game screenshot, not a poster or advertisement, no device frame. Orthographic three-quarter view of a tiny farm on a layered earthen coastal cliff surrounded by muted deep slate blue water and pale mist. About 24 clearly readable square land tiles, only about 16 remain, with distinct empty sea gaps where land was lost. Warm green grass tops, angular dark ochre soil cliff faces, compact low-poly wooden farmhouse, water barrel, short fences, and simple geometric crop patches of differing growth. Entire gameplay area fits in the screen. Core mechanic front and center: along the front-right coast a SINGLE planted soil tile is cracking and subsiding, a few angular earth chunks falling, red dashed outline on endangered neighbor; two other tiles protected by simple timber retaining walls. This is quiet, melancholy, tactical land loss, not a giant explosion or disaster spectacle. A selected inland plot outlined in warm yellow shows the choice of which land to save. Soft late autumn afternoon light, matte flat shaded meshes and ambient occlusion, simple achievable Kenney-style asset density, no detailed characters needed. Professional minimal UI with clean Korean typography: top left "밭이 줄어드는 세계", top right "2년차 · 가을". Compact top resource strip "남은 땅 16 / 24" and "목재 12" and "물 8". A narrow right panel "침식 예보", a small coast icon, text "다음 계절에 2칸 위험". Bottom-center three clear controls "심기", "방벽 설치", "계절 넘기기"; selected wall action highlights threatened coast. Small bottom-left tooltip "이 땅을 지키면, 다른 곳을 포기해야 합니다." Make UI readable without covering farmland. Restrained green/ochre/navy palette with small coral-red warning accents. No dense city, no large open world, no photoreal materials, no glossy toy plastic, no decorative unreadable paragraphs, no watermark. This is a proposed visual mockup, not implemented gameplay.
